verdict.rationale: Snowflake's docs explain the credit-based compute model: virtual warehouses consume credits while running and are user-managed, so you control consumption [snowflake-docs-36, snowflake-docs-40]. The pricing page outlines edition tiers [snowflake-docs-49]. A community user adds a hands-on data point (9 credits plus 40GB storage came to about $19.60) and notes that credits double with each warehouse size [snowflake-comm-1]. That is enough to reason about relative cost, but the pack lacks the concrete rates and estimation tooling needed to project a monthly bill before committing. Missing for 10: published per-credit and per-TB storage rates by edition and region, a pricing calculator or estimation guide, documented credit-per-hour rates per warehouse size, and coverage of serverless/AI feature pricing.
